high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "lizzieguitarstuff." The post was made 17 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post features a vibrant and surreal background with a sky filled with dramatic clouds illuminated by golden sunlight, creating a dreamy and ethereal atmosphere. In the center of the image, there is a colorful album cover for the artist Grimes' album "Art Angels." The album cover art depicts a stylized, somewhat eerie face with exaggerated features, including large eyes and a braid.
